river_match.why: ?river= names ONE WALK — its layer_code, its key, an unambiguous first segment of its key, or the river tag its own records carry — and this body is that walk's alone. Whether any other banked walk composes the same river is the geo.rivers.v1 registry's and is not banked in Neon (D-09-25-252 §5, pantry lane d091790), so they are named here rather than composed: ?river=willamette answers for willamette_hcr_columbia by itself, never for the basin's nine walks.
